### Manual App updates

- Check for a new version in System → Startup & connection → App updates, then choose Update and restart.
- Palboo downloads and verifies the complete App, preserves your settings, and restores the previous App if installation or startup fails. Codex keeps running.
- Checks and downloads start only when you request them. Unsaved settings are protected; development mode allows checks, with installation available after switching to release mode.
- Existing Dock pins keep their position and point to the updated App. Source-only releases show their notes without an install action.

### 手动更新 App

- 在「系统 → 启动与连接 → 应用更新」检查新版，再点击「更新并重启」。
- 自动下载并校验完整 App，保留设置；安装或启动失败时恢复旧 App，Codex 保持运行。
- 检查和下载都由你主动触发。未保存设置时禁止安装；开发模式可以检查，切回正式模式后可安装。
- 已有 Dock 固定图标保持原位置并指向新版 App；只有源码的版本显示更新说明，不提供安装操作。
